result.note: Tests the Malvan commissioning: its class, builder and shallow-water anti-submarine role.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Indian Navy announced the commissioning of Malvan. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It is the second vessel of the Mahe class of Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft.
It was built at Cochin Shipyard Limited in Kochi with over 80 per cent indigenous content.
It is designed mainly for anti-submarine operations in deep ocean waters.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The third statement is wrong. Malvan is built for anti-submarine work in shallow coastal waters, where larger warships cannot operate effectively. It was scheduled to be commissioned on 22 July 2026.
questions.source: Built at Cochin Shipyard Limited in Kochi with over 80 per cent indigenous content, the craft is designed for anti-submarine work in shallow coastal waters, where larger warships cannot operate effectively.
